items.name: 辛諾鵬
items.note:
To TAs:

Hello,

I have some questions. 

1. What is the purpose of the NOTICE section ? What does "trace the code" mean ? Do I need to write about every function in the header file linux/list.h ?

2. What is the order in "Order should not be wrong" ?

3. What is the form of the data ? For eg- does the first one have to be like 106062540 or can it be 1234 ?

4. Can I make changes to the Makefile ?

5. Can I print each element, as I delete it, or just "Success !" at the end ?

Thank you very much.

items.name: 洪若恒
items.note:
Hi,

1. You just need to trace the code in <linux/list.h> and understand how to use those functions. It will be useful for your homework. If you use some functions in <linux/list.h>, you should tell us how you use them in your report.

2.  The order means the order in the list above, which means the order of your output should be 106062540 ->106062899 -> 106062569 -> 106061359 -> 106054893

3. The form of the data should be the same as the picture, which means your output form should be {studentID, day-month-year.}.

4. Sure you can, but you should upload your Makefile when you hand in your homework just in case.

5. You can print anything you want.

Good luck!
